title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378R (Powers and functions of Board)

content.overview: Subject to the Act and the articles, the Board of Directors of a Producer Company shall exercise all such powers and do all such acts and things as the Company is authorised to do. Without prejudice to that generality, the Board’s powers include determination of dividend, determination of withheld price and recommendation of patronage, admission of new Members, formulation of organisational policy and strategies, appointment and supervision of the Chief Executive and other officers, maintenance of books and preparation of annual accounts, and the other matters listed in the section. A director or group of directors who do not constitute the Board shall not exercise Board powers.
content.glance: The Board exercises the company’s authorised powers, including the listed financial, membership, policy and management functions; non-Board directors cannot exercise Board powers.
content.study: Section 378R confers on the Board the residual managerial power of the Producer Company, subject to the Act and the articles, and enumerates particular powers. The Explanation confirms that only the Board as a whole (not individual or minority directors) may exercise those powers. Certain matters remain reserved for general-meeting resolutions under section 378S.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Board exercises all powers the Producer Company is authorised to exercise, including the listed functions; only the Board as a whole may exercise them.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378R
examples.body: The Board determines the quantum of withheld price and recommends patronage for approval at the general meeting under s. 378R(2)(b).

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378R?
hypotheticals.analysis: It confers residual Board power and lists specific functions, while barring non-Board directors from exercising Board powers.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming a single director may exercise Board powers.
misconceptions.correction: The Explanation to s. 378R states that a director or group who do not constitute the Board shall not exercise Board powers.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378R be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State residual Board power. II. List key enumerated functions. III. Note the Board-only rule.
